description: Priya onboarding new hire Dev (buddy program).

messages.text: Welcome @Dev to the team! 🎉 I'll be your onboarding buddy. Start with the payments onboarding guide (go/payments-onboarding) and grab 30 min with me tomorrow.
messages.label: onboarding

messages.text: Here's your week-1 plan: env setup, read the ledger ADRs, ship a tiny PR by Friday. I've set up daily 15-min check-ins.
messages.label: onboarding

messages.text: Booked you a session with Meera to understand the product side, and with Rahul for fraud context.
messages.label: onboarding

messages.text: @Dev shipped his first PR today in week 1 🎉 — thanks to everyone who reviewed.
messages.label: onboarding

messages.text: Week 3 check-in: you're ready to pick up the velocity checks ticket solo. I'll be your reviewer.
messages.label: onboarding

messages.text: For new folks: I recorded a 20-min walkthrough of the payments architecture — link is in the onboarding guide.
messages.label: onboarding
